episodes.title: Of Ballads, Brawlers, and Bloodied Blades
episodes.summary: A tavern brawl puts Éile on a collision course with destiny, emotions get the best of Fjall after a close call, and a royal betrayal leads to bloodshed.

episodes.title: Of Dreams, Defiance, and Desperate Deeds
episodes.summary: In need of coin to fund their quest, Éile, Fjall and Scían hatch a risky scheme that leads to a firestorm of trouble. Merwyn stumbles on a secret.

episodes.title: Of Warriors, Wakes, and Wondrous Worlds
episodes.summary: After meeting Meldof and her beloved Gwen, the warriors put a perilous end game in motion as truths are revealed, passions kindled — and sacrifices made.

episodes.title: Of Mages, Malice, and Monstrous Mayhem
episodes.summary: As Merwyn forges an uneasy alliance to achieve her plans for Elfkind, the battle begins in Xintrea, where Éile finds her voice and Fjall loses control.
